verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph's documented Mail API gives any HTTP-capable client, including an agent, the full email loop: reading and querying messages, triage actions (categories, flags, importance, inbox rules), and drafting and sending via sendMail. However, the pack documents no agent-ready connection such as an official MCP server or a Claude/ChatGPT connector, so the user or developer must wire the agent to the raw REST API themselves. missing for 10: an official agent connector or MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT, agent-oriented setup docs (no llms.txt or OpenAPI found by the probes), and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full read-triage-draft-send loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection
